en: Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
zh: 新增 `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces`，使 Linux 上沙箱内的命令可以创建用户命名空间（Chromium、rootless podman）；这样它们就能绕过沙箱的文件保护
